name: io.github.cantbeblank96/qodercli-mcp
description: MCP server mode for Qoder CLI — delegate coding tasks to local Qoder agents from any MCP client.

environmentVariables.name: QODERCLI_PATH
environmentVariables.description: Absolute path to the qodercli binary (defaults to `qodercli` on PATH)

environmentVariables.name: QODERCLI_DEFAULT_PERMISSION_MODE
environmentVariables.description: Default permission mode when callers omit permission params: dont_ask (default, read-only) | accept_edits | bypass_permissions | auto | default

environmentVariables.name: HTTP_PROXY
environmentVariables.description: HTTP proxy injected into qodercli subprocesses (optional)

environmentVariables.name: HTTPS_PROXY
environmentVariables.description: HTTPS proxy injected into qodercli subprocesses (optional)
